description: Get a single video by its ID with the current processing status. Use it to poll after upload_video: the status walks UPLOADED -> PROCESSING -> READY (the `content` field with the player links is filled only in READY) or ends in ERROR (details in `error`). Poll at most once every 5 seconds — processing time scales with the video length.

video_id.description: Video ID from the upload_video or list_videos response — an opaque string, not a UUID.

name: get_video
title: Get video
